gaps.sentence: The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.

gaps.sentence: The team celebrated a quick ___ (SOLVE) to the crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'A solution to the crisis' — the noun.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.
